name: El Recuenco (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Recuenco (a green bottle between two brown mounts on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of El Recuenco; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: El Recuenco arms — bottle between two mounts on yellow
